paragraphs.en: Franz Boas's {description} of Inuit life in the 19th century illustrates the probable moral {code} of early humans.Here, norms ( (规范) ) were {unwritten} and rarely expressed clearly, but were well understood and taken to heart. {Dishonest} and {violent} behaviors were {disapproved} of; {leadership} , {marriage,} and interactions with other groups were {loosely} {governed} by {traditions} .Conflict was often resolved in musical {battles} .Because arguing {angrily} leads to {chaos} , it was {strongly} discouraged.With life in the {unforgiving} {northern} Canada being so demanding, the Inuit's {practical} approach to {morality} made good sense.
paragraphs.cn: 弗朗兹·博厄斯对19世纪因纽特人生活的 <u> 描述 </u> ，展现了早期人类可能遵循的道德 <u> 准则 </u> 。在这里（指因纽特社会），规范虽 <u> 不成文 </u> ，也很少被清楚地表述出来，但人们都心领神会并铭记于心。 <u> 不诚实 </u> 和 <u> 暴力 </u> 行为 <u> 不被认可 </u> ； <u> 领导 </u> 权、 <u> 婚姻 </u> ，以及与其他群体间的互动，都 <u> 大致 </u> 受到 <u> 传统 </u> 的 <u> 约束 </u> 。人们往往通过音乐 <u> 较量 </u> 化解冲突。因为 <u> 愤怒 </u> 争吵会引起 <u> 混乱 </u> ，所以这种行为遭到 <u> 强烈 </u> 反对。鉴于加拿大 <u> 北部 </u> 环境 <u> 恶劣 </u> ，生活艰辛，因纽特人这种 <u> 务实的道德 </u> 观念可谓合情合理。

paragraphs.en: The {similarity} of moral {virtues} across cultures is {striking} , even though the relative ranking of the virtues may vary with a social group's history and environment. {Typically} , cruelty and {cheating} are discouraged, while {cooperation} , {humbleness,} and courage are praised.These {universal} norms far {pre-date} the concept of any {moralizing} religion or written {law} .Rather, they are rooted in the similarity of basic human needs and our shared mechanisms for learning and problem solving.Our social instincts ( (本能) ) include the intense desire to {belong} .The {approval} of others is rewarding, while their {disapproval} is strongly {disliked} .These social emotions {prepare} our brains to shape our behavior according to the norms and values of our family and our community.More generally, social instincts motivate us to learn how to {behave} in a {socially} complex world.
paragraphs.cn: 不同文化中，道德 <u> 美德 </u> 有着 <u> 惊人的相似性 </u> ，尽管因为社会群体的历史和环境各异，美德相对的重要性在排序上可能有所差异。 <u> 通常来说 </u> ，残酷和 <u> 欺骗 </u> 不受鼓励，而 <u> 合作 </u> 、 <u> 谦逊 </u> 和勇气会受到赞扬。这些 <u> 普遍的 </u> 规范远远 <u> 早于 </u> 任何 <u> 道德化的 </u> 宗教或成文 <u> 法规 </u> 而存在。更确切地说，它们植根于人类基本需求的相似性，以及人类共有的学习和解决问题的机制。我们的社会本能包括强烈的 <u> 归属 </u> 欲。他人的 <u> 赞同 </u> 会带来愉悦感，而他人的 <u> 反对 </u> 则令人 <u> 厌恶 </u> 至极。这些社会情感使我们的大脑 <u> 做好准备 </u> ，从而根据家庭和社群的规范和价值观来塑造自身行为。更普遍地说，社会本能促使我们学习如何在复杂的 <u> 社会 </u> 环境中 <u> 行事 </u> 。

paragraphs.en: The mechanism involves a {repurposed} reward system originally used to develop habits important for {self-care} .Our brains use the system to {acquire} {behavioral} patterns regarding safe routes home, efficient food {gathering,} and dangers to avoid.Good habits save time, energy and sometimes your life.Good social habits do something similar in a social context.We learn to tell the truth, even when lying is {self-serving} ; we help a {grandparent} even when it is {inconvenient} .We acquire what we call a sense of right and wrong.
paragraphs.cn: 这一机制涉及一个 <u> 经改造 </u> 的奖励系统，该系统最初用于培养对 <u> 自我照顾 </u> 至关重要的习惯。我们的大脑利用该系统来 <u> 获得 </u> 多种 <u> 行为 </u> 模式：如何找到安全的回家路线、如何高效地 <u> 觅 </u> 食，以及该躲避哪些危险。好习惯可以节省时间、精力，有时甚至可以救命。良好的社交习惯在人际环境中也具有类似的作用。我们学着说真话，即使撒谎 <u> 对自己有利 </u> ；我们会帮助 <u> 祖父/祖母 </u> ，即使这并 <u> 不方便 </u> 。我们学会了所谓的是非观念。

paragraphs.en: Social benefits are accompanied by social demands: we must get along, but not put up with too much.Hence {self-discipline} is {advantageous} .In humans, a greatly {enlarged} brain boosts {self-control} , just as it boosts problem-solving skills in the social as well as the physical world.These abilities are strengthened by our {capacity} for language, which allows social practices to develop in extremely unobvious ways.
paragraphs.cn: 社交收益与社交需求相伴——我们必须和睦相处，但不能过度忍让。因此， <u> 自律 </u> 是 <u> 有利的 </u> 。对人类而言，大幅 <u> 进化 </u> 的大脑增强了 <u> 自制力 </u> ，就如同它在社会和物质世界中提升了解决问题的能力一样。我们的语言 <u> 能力 </u> 进一步强化了这些能力，使得社会实践以极为微妙的方式发展。 5NoOncib/NjiX02BpMIzP4m+378Hw1xTRxUdPaP/PFjKUFq4K2G7tp6ZLYoCE601yW1W39VMdLmovFdSHs4nVQ==
